title: Stand Next to Life-Size Orcas at LA's Natural History Museum
description:
Come face-to-face with life-size orcas and explore more than 35 million fascinating treasures at the Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County, the oldest and largest natural history museum on the West Coast.

From towering marine mammals and world-class natural history collections to the seasonal Butterfly Pavilion and dazzling Gem and Mineral Hall, the museum offers an unforgettable journey through the natural world. Visitors can experience the special Orca exhibit, featuring life-size replicas that reveal how these remarkable animals relate to humans, Indigenous communities, and the broader ocean ecosystem—while learning why orcas are actually the largest members of the dolphin family.

Whether you're interested in science, history, archaeology, or wildlife, the Natural History Museum offers something for visitors of all ages.

Plan your visit https://nhm.org/
